title: ADIDAS AURA ANIMATION
features:
👟 ADIDAS AURA ANIMATION 🚀
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Transform your character's movement with the viral Adidas Aura animation pack. This script smoothly replaces your default Idle, Walk, Run, Jump, and Fall animations using high-priority overrides.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ FEATURES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✅ Viral Animations — Adidas Aura Idle, Walk, Run, Jump, and Fall.
✅ Smooth Transitions — Seamless switching between states without snapping.
✅ High Priority — Uses Action4 priority to override default game animations.
✅ Animation Bypass — Built-in resolver to load animations in games that normally block custom IDs.
✅ Auto-Apply — Works automatically upon execution and respawn.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ HOW TO USE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. Join any Roblox game.
2. Execute the script in your executor.
3. The animations will automatically apply to your character.
4. Move around, jump, and fall to see the Adidas Aura in action!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ NOTE FOR MODERATORS (Please Read)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This script is obfuscated to protect the specific animation bypass logic from being patched by game developers. Here is exactly what the code does:
1. It extracts the real, unblocked Animation IDs using `HumanoidDescription` and `game:GetObjects`.
2. It loads these animations into the player's `Animator` with `Action4` priority (the highest priority, forcing it to override default game animations).
3. It uses a `RunService.Heartbeat` loop to monitor the player's Humanoid state (Idle, Walk, Run, Jump, Fall) and plays the correct animation smoothly.

There are no malicious payloads, token loggers, webhooks, or hidden remote executions. It is purely a cosmetic animation replacer.
